meta.name: Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen
meta.description: The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.

videos.title: Welcome to the Narita Family
videos.overview: Only-child Ito’s life changes overnight when her mom remarries—and she gains four new stepbrothers!

videos.title: Lies Make Families
videos.overview: Ito suggest Mom goes with Dad since they just got married. But Gen tells Ito to go as well and not come back?!

videos.title: The Narita Family’s New Rule
videos.overview: Ito's midterm scores are terrible, so Raku helps her study in secret because Gen can't find out!

videos.title: Unable to Be Honest
videos.overview: Gomez has run away, and during the search Gen gets hurt. Even then, he won't allow Ito to take care of him.

videos.title: Shut Away Angel
videos.overview: The whole family is together for a BBQ -- except the shut in, Shu. Can Ito finally get through to him?

videos.title: Siblings’ Feelings
videos.overview: Ito and Shu's party is facing their fiercest opponent yet. Can they overcome this challenge and break free?

videos.title: My Younger Brother Is a Prince?
videos.overview: It's summer, so the family goes to see Ito's friends. Back in school, Gen is forced to be a prince for a play?

videos.title: What’ll Happen to the Cultural Festival?!
videos.overview: Ito feels some way about Gen, but she’s not sure what exactly. Udagawa sees right through her and says it's...

videos.title: The Birthday Present Bonus
videos.overview: Ito realizes she has romantic feelings for Gen. Raku finds out, and Gen overhears them talking about it.

videos.title: A Sign of Connection
videos.overview: Shu has a cosplayer friend?! Shu wants to meet this friend at an IRL event, but can he muster the courage?

videos.title: The Hiroshima Onomichi Steam Incident
videos.overview: Ito and Gen end up sightseeing alone on the school trip, and then something unexpected occurs…?!

videos.title: Let the Memories Fall
videos.overview: It's Christmas and everyone is home! After a huge party, Ito learns this day is very special for the Naritas.

videos.title: Into the New Year! Valentines!
videos.overview: As Raku's out shopping on NYE, a woman asks to borrow his phone. Then she asks Raku for a favor...

videos.title: This Love Can't Be Suppressed
videos.overview: Since Valentine's, Ito wavers between just confessing her love to Gen, and protecting the order of the family.

videos.title: How I Really Feel
videos.overview: Since hearing how Gen feels, Ito is completely distracted and falls down the stairs...

videos.title: The Troubled Narita Brothers
videos.overview: Being rejected has torn a hole in Ito's heart. Gen also doesn't know how to act. What can be done to fix it?

videos.title: Clashing Thoughts
videos.overview: Syu figures out how Gen really feels about Ito. To settle things, he challenges Gen to a fight.

videos.title: Piggy-Back Fight! Brother vs Brother
videos.overview: Gen and Syu are to face off in a piggy-back fight at the sports festival. What's the result of their fight?!
